title: "OpenBloom": A Question-Based LLM Tool to Support Stigma Reduction in Reproductive Well-Being
findings: The study found that reproductive health stigma is deeply intertwined with cultural and religious beliefs. Participants warned that AI must navigate these topics with care, avoiding direct contradiction of religiously significant beliefs, which could be perceived as dismissive of their heritage. The AI struggled to provide this nuance, often defaulting to superficial factual questions. A key design recommendation was to frame information from a medical perspective ('research shows...') rather than an absolute one ('this is the truth...') to respect diverse epistemologies, including religious ones, and to avoid targeting specific religious groups when correcting misinformation.
